name: xero-mcp
description: Every Xero Accounting read plus a local SQLite ledger — aging, reconciliation, and GL tie-out that no other Xero tool computes offline.

xero_access_token.title: XERO_ACCESS_TOKEN
xero_access_token.description: Optional. Sets XERO_ACCESS_TOKEN for the Xero MCP server.

xero_oauth2.title: XERO_OAUTH2
xero_oauth2.description: Optional. Sets XERO_OAUTH2 for the Xero MCP server.

xero_tenant_id.title: Xero tenant ID
xero_tenant_id.description: The Xero organisation ('tenant') GUID sent as the Xero-Tenant-Id header. Every call requires it; `connections list` returns the tenants your token can reach.

xero_authorization_url.title: OAuth authorization URL
xero_authorization_url.description: Authorization endpoint the login flow opens. Change it only if Xero moves the endpoint.

xero_base_url.title: Xero API base URL
xero_base_url.description: Base URL for the Xero API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

xero_client_id.title: Xero app client ID
xero_client_id.description: Client ID of your Xero app (developer.xero.com > My Apps). Set it with the client secret to run the OAuth2 flow; leave blank if you paste an access token instead.

xero_token_url.title: OAuth2 token URL
xero_token_url.description: Token endpoint the client-credentials exchange posts to. Leave the prefilled default unless your tenant uses a different token endpoint.

xero_no_config_write.title: Keep credentials off disk
xero_no_config_write.description: Set to 1 to keep credentials off disk. The token cache becomes a no-op, so the connector mints a fresh token each run instead of writing one to config.toml. Leave blank for the default cached behaviour.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.

xero_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
xero_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing execute call. Leave blank to keep every tool available (writes still need confirm).

xero_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
xero_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and the response cache is off. Leave blank to keep the local data.

xero_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
xero_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

xero_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
xero_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Xero requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

xero_scopes.title: OAuth scopes (optional)
xero_scopes.description: Comma or space separated OAuth scopes requested by auth login, replacing the default set. Leave blank for the default scopes.

spacefast_token.title: Spacefast token (optional)
spacefast_token.description: Only for the CLI's --deliver spacefast option, which publishes a command's output as a Spacefast page in your account. MCP tools cannot use --deliver. Leave blank otherwise.

spacefast_team.title: Spacefast team (optional)
spacefast_team.description: Picks the Spacefast team for --deliver spacefast when the token belongs to several. Leave blank otherwise.

spacefast_api_url.title: Spacefast API URL (optional)
spacefast_api_url.description: Overrides the Spacefast API address used by --deliver spacefast. Leave blank for the default.
